```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: Posterior summaries from the multivariate Bayesian mixed-effects model examining the relationship between egg number and mean egg size. The model jointly estimated a negative binomial model for egg number and a Gaussian model for egg size, including brood effects and partitioning egg number into within- and between-female components. Reported values are posterior medians and 95% credible intervals (CrI). Random effects represent among-female (ID-level) variation, and the correlation term describes the association between female intercepts for egg number and egg size. The dispersion parameter refers to the negative binomial shape parameter.

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS (Mean model)
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- fit_mv |>
  spread_draws(
    b_meaneggsize_Intercept,
    b_meaneggsize_broodtwo,
    b_meaneggsize_egg_number_within_z,
    b_meaneggsize_egg_number_between_z,
    b_eggnumber_Intercept,
    b_eggnumber_broodtwo
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      b_meaneggsize_Intercept = "Egg size: Intercept (Brood 1)",
      b_meaneggsize_broodtwo = "Egg size: Brood 2 − Brood 1",
      b_meaneggsize_egg_number_within_z =
        "Egg size: Within-female deviation in egg number (z)",
      b_meaneggsize_egg_number_between_z =
        "Egg size: Between-female deviation in egg number (z)",
      b_eggnumber_Intercept =
        "Egg number: Intercept (Brood 1, log scale)",
      b_eggnumber_broodtwo =
        "Egg number: Brood 2 − Brood 1 (log scale)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM EFFECTS (Female ID)
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- fit_mv |>
  spread_draws(
    sd_id__meaneggsize_Intercept,
    sd_id__eggnumber_Intercept,
    cor_id__eggnumber_Intercept__meaneggsize_Intercept
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
               names_to = "term",
               values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sd_id__meaneggsize_Intercept =
        "SD (Egg size | Female ID)",
      sd_id__eggnumber_Intercept =
        "SD (Egg number | Female ID)",
      cor_id__meaneggsize_Intercept__eggnumber_Intercept =
        "Correlation (Egg size, Egg number | Female ID)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 3a. RESIDUAL SD (Egg size)
# -----------------------------

sigma_tab <- fit_mv |>
  spread_draws(sigma_meaneggsize) |>
  median_qi(sigma_meaneggsize, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Residual SD (Egg size)",
    Estimate = round(sigma_meaneggsize, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 3b. Negative Binomial Shape
# -----------------------------

shape_tab <- fit_mv |>
  spread_draws(shape_eggnumber) |>
  median_qi(shape_eggnumber, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Dispersion (Egg number | NegBin shape)",
    Estimate = round(shape_eggnumber, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)

# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE ALL TABLES
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,
  random_tab,
  sigma_tab,
  shape_tab
)

flextable(final_tab) |>
  autofit()
```

\newpage

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: FALSE
#| label: tbl-six
#| tbl-cap: Posterior medians and 95% credible intervals from a Bayesian mixed model of scaled egg perimeter, including clutch-specific means, clutch-specific female-level random effects, and clutch-specific residual variance.

# -----------------------------
# 1. FIXED EFFECTS (Mean model)
# -----------------------------

fixed_tab <- egg.size.model.alt |>
  spread_draws(
    b_Intercept,
    b_brood_factortwo
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      b_Intercept = "Mean (Brood 1)",
      b_brood_factortwo = "Brood 2 − Brood 1"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 2. RANDOM EFFECTS (ID level)
# -----------------------------

random_tab <- egg.size.model.alt |>
  spread_draws(
    sd_id__brood_factorone,
    sd_id__brood_factortwo,
    cor_id__brood_factorone__brood_factortwo
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sd_id__brood_factorone = "SD (Brood 1 | Female ID)",
      sd_id__brood_factortwo = "SD (Brood 2 | Female ID)",
      cor_id__brood_factorone__brood_factortwo =
        "Correlation (Brood 1, Brood 2 | Female ID)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 3. RESIDUAL SD (back-transformed)
# -----------------------------

sigma_tab <- egg.size.model.alt |>
  spread_draws(
    b_sigma_Intercept,
    b_sigma_brood_factortwo
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sigma_brood1 = exp(b_sigma_Intercept),
    sigma_brood2 = exp(b_sigma_Intercept + b_sigma_brood_factortwo)
  ) |>
  select(-.chain, -.iteration, -.draw) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sigma_brood1, sigma_brood2),
    names_to = "term",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  median_qi(value, .width = 0.95) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Parameter = recode(term,
      sigma_brood1 = "Residual SD (Brood 1)",
      sigma_brood2 = "Residual SD (Brood 2)"
    ),
    Estimate = round(value, 3),
    `Lower 95% CrI` = round(.lower, 3),
    `Upper 95% CrI` = round(.upper, 3)
  ) |>
  select(Parameter, Estimate, `Lower 95% CrI`, `Upper 95% CrI`)


# -----------------------------
# 4. COMBINE
# -----------------------------

final_tab <- bind_rows(
  fixed_tab,
  random_tab,
  sigma_tab
)

flextable(final_tab) |>
  autofit()
```
